cd /home/john/mynotes/shadow_frontier && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'search')
from frontier import realize
def v2(n): return (n & -n).bit_length()-1

msg = "GHOST"
bits = ''.join(f"{ord(c):08b}" for c in msg)
print(f"message bits: {len(bits)} ({bits.count('1')} ones, {bits.count('0')} zeros)")

# naive scheme: 0->1, 1->2
w_naive = [1 if c=='0' else 2 for c in bits]
r1, Mb1 = realize(w_naive)
print(f"naive  scheme: B+1 = {Mb1}, integer = {r1} ({r1.bit_length()} bits)")

# Kraft-optimal scheme: letter b encodes the block 1^(b-1) 0
s = bits + '0'                       # pad so the stream ends in 0
word, run = [], 0
for c in s:
    if c == '1': run += 1
    else: word.append(run + 1); run = 0
r2, Mb2 = realize(word)
print(f"Kraft  scheme: {len(word)} letters (max letter {max(word)}), "
      f"B+1 = {Mb2}, integer = {r2} ({r2.bit_length()} bits)")

# read back: letters -> blocks -> bits -> chars
x, out = r2, []
for _ in range(len(word)):
    t = 3*x+1; b = v2(t); x = t >> b
    out.append('1'*(b-1) + '0')
back = ''.join(out)[:len(bits)]
dec = ''.join(chr(int(back[i:i+8],2)) for i in range(0,len(back),8))
print(f"read back: '{dec}' (match: {dec==msg})")
print(f"cost: naive {Mb1/len(bits):.3f}, Kraft {Mb2/len(bits):.3f} "
      f"seed bits per message bit")
